summary.text: George Flint is the Republican nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 70, and a former judge of the Texas 401st District Court.
He held that judgeship from January 1, 2021 to December 31, 2024.

paragraphs.text: Flint earned a bachelor's degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1972, a degree from Wake Forest University in 1974 and a law degree from the Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in 1980, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described a technology background from MIT, an MBA from Wake Forest, and legal work with healthcare providers, and said he has lived in House District 70 for over 35 years.
Flint won the 2020 general election for the Texas 401st District Court over Tonya J. Holt, and he did not run for re-election in 2024.

In his 2026 survey, he listed eliminating property taxes for homeowners, lowering healthcare costs, including full practice authority for nurse practitioners, and cutting government waste as his key messages.
